name: _structure.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  _structure.scss — the runtime design system MANIFEST.
//  Publishes every SCSS token as a CSS custom property on :root (+ the
//  html.dark-mode overrides and the skeleton/theme surface tokens). This is
//  THE layer where $ vars become var()s — component stylesheets must read
//  the vars, never the $ tokens. Also defines the reset, the global skeleton
//  shimmer keyframes (pure CSS animation — no JS loop), the genie dialog
//  transform-origin contract (--genie-x/--genie-y), and the z-index scale.
//
//  Split by domain into structure/ partials (imported below):
//    _tokens          :root token publication (colors → plasma)
//    _dark-mode       html.dark-mode token overrides
//    _document        html/body resets, backdrop drift, #app, element reset
//    _skeleton-utils  skeleton keyframes + classes + focus-ring emit
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import 'structure/tokens';
@import 'structure/dark-mode';
@import 'structure/document';
@import 'structure/skeleton-utils';
@import 'structure/a11y';
